colourRules.title: File colours
colourRules.description: A filename mask on the left, a colour on the right. The first rule that matches wins, so the order is yours to set — a rule above the container rule picks one file out of the rest. Several masks go in one rule, separated by ;. Anything no rule matches keeps ART's own colouring.

drivers.title: File system drivers in the RDB
drivers.none: None. That is correct for a disk using only the file systems Kickstart already has — the Old and Fast File Systems, DOS types 0 to 7.
drivers.missing_one: {{names}} names a file system this disk does not carry. An Amiga will not mount it — silently, with no error. The driver has to be added to the RDB.
drivers.missing_other: {{count}} partitions name file systems this disk does not carry ({{names}}). An Amiga will not mount them — silently, with no error.

hardDisk.emptyState: Open an existing .hdf image or click "{{wizard}}" to create an Amiga hard disk.

modal.title: Create New Amiga Hard Disk (HDF)

driver.label: 4. File System Driver:
driver.dialogTitle: Choose the file system driver to embed
driver.explain: Kickstart has no {{dosType}} filesystem, so it has to travel inside the disk itself. Point ART at the driver — {{hint}}, usually — and it goes into the RDB with the version it states about itself.
driver.warning: Without a driver an Amiga will not see these partitions at all. The image is still made; it will not mount until a driver is added.

modal.warnOver4Gb: A single {{size}} GB partition is past the 4 GB that standard AmigaDOS can address; it needs TD64 or NSD support in both the controller and the filesystem. Fine for an emulator, and for a machine that has them — split the disk if it does not.

custom.notANumber: That is not a size. Type a number greater than zero.
custom.notWholeMegabytes: Sizes are whole megabytes — 0.5 GB is fine, 12.5 MB is not.
custom.tooSmall: The smallest hard disk image ART will build is {{min}} MB.

move.refuseLocalSource: ART does not delete files on your own disk, so it cannot move them off it. Copy them with F5 and remove them yourself.
move.refuseReadOnlySource: Nothing can be moved out of a disc, an archive or a Commodore image — ART only ever reads them. Copy with F5 instead.
move.refuseSourceNotWritable: This volume does not take writes, so the entries cannot be removed from it. Copy with F5 instead.
move.refuseReadOnlyTarget: The other pane is read-only, so nothing can be moved into it.
move.refuseTargetNotWritable: Open a volume that takes writes on the other side first.
move.refuseFileBetweenImages: Moving a single file between two images is not supported yet — a folder can be moved, and a file can be copied with F5.
move.refuseCollision_one: {{names}} is already there. A move never overwrites and never silently skips — rename one of them first.
move.refuseCollision_other: {{count}} of these names are already there ({{names}}). A move never overwrites and never silently skips — rename them first.
